conteudo: CBSoft 2026 will take place at two locations within the University of São Paulo's campus: the Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism (FAU-USP) and the Institute of Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science (IME-USP).
**Attention:** registration and the talks starting at 9:00 AM will take place at **FAU-USP**. When you arrive at the event, please go to FAU first to register and attend the initial activities.

From the Av. Rebouças and Av. Paulista area, you can reach the event by public transportation (affordable, R\$ 5.30), Uber/99/taxi (~R\$ 35), or BikeSampa shared bicycles (the healthiest option). Bus fares can be paid in cash (small bills), through the Cittamobi app via Bluetooth, or, on most buses, with a contactless debit/credit card (NFC).
Google Maps provides good public transportation routes. We particularly recommend:
1. Bus 7411-10 (Cidade Universitária) (recommended) - runs every 15 minutes along Av. Rebouças or R. da Consolação. Get off at FEA-USP.

2. Bus 702U-10 (Cidade Universitária) - runs along Av. Rebouças or R. da Consolação. Get off at CRUSP (a pleasant and safe 10-minute walk) or at IME (the bus makes a short loop through Cidade Universitária before arriving).
3. Metro Line 4 (Yellow) - get off at Butantã Station, then take Bus 8084-10 (Cidade Universitária via Luciano Gualberto), or use Uber/99/taxi or a BikeSampa shared bicycle (ride carefully).
